agent.description: An approve/reject gate for a consequential action (an agent_action build/connector change, a synthesis proposal, a review finding). Render this when a tool result asks you to surface an approval — the analyst clicks Approve/Reject and the ActionRouter executes. `target_id` + `target_kind` come from the tool result; do not fabricate them.
A built product artifact (report/deck/source-pack) with its status.

A chart visualizing quantitative data. Provide a self-contained Vega-Lite spec in `vega_lite_spec` with data embedded under `data.values` (array of row objects). Use for comparisons, trends, distributions, or benchmark numbers the analyst asks you to plot.

vega_lite_spec.description: A complete Vega-Lite spec with embedded data.

agent.description: A single factual claim with its confidence and citations. Use when surfacing one well-scoped assertion grounded in the wiki.
A revision diff for a wiki page (from_revision_id → to_revision_id). Render when showing what changed between two wiki revisions. Supply `from_body_md`/`to_body_md` to render a real line diff.
A reviewer finding (contradiction, weak source, coverage gap) with a severity.
A dynamic input form. Use to collect structured input conversationally (parameters, choices) instead of free text. `fields` is an array of field specs ([{name,label,type,options?}]).
A research hypothesis with its current confidence and evidence count.
A reference to an ingested source with its processing status.
A sortable, filterable data table. Provide `columns` ([{name,label}]) and `rows` (array of objects keyed by column name).

primitives.AudioPlayer: An audio player for a `url`. Use for a recording or a spoken source; for anything visual use Video or Image.
primitives.Button: A clickable button. `child` is the id of its label component.
primitives.Card: A bordered container wrapping one child component (id in `child`).
primitives.CheckBox: A single on/off switch with a `label`. Bind `value` to a boolean in the data model. For a set of choices use ChoicePicker, not a row of these.
primitives.ChoicePicker: Pick from a fixed list of `options` ({label, value}). `variant: mutuallyExclusive` is a radio group / dropdown, `multipleSelection` is a multi-select; `value` binds to an ARRAY of the selected values in both cases. Use this rather than free text whenever the accepted values are known.
primitives.Column: A vertical stack of child components (referenced by id in `children`).
primitives.DateTimeInput: A date and/or time picker. Set `enableDate` / `enableTime` for which halves are offered; `value` is an ISO 8601 string, seeded with "" when unset.
primitives.List: A list of child components (ids in `children`).
primitives.Modal: A dialog: `trigger` is the id of the component that opens it, `content` the id of what it shows. Both must be defined as separate components — a Modal holds ids, never inline children.
primitives.Row: A horizontal arrangement of child components (ids in `children`).
primitives.Slider: A bounded numeric input. `max` is REQUIRED — without a ceiling there is no track to drag along. Use a TextField with `variant: number` for an unbounded number.
primitives.Tabs: A tabbed container; each entry in `tabs` names a title and a content id.
primitives.Text: A run of text. `text` is the string; `variant` sets heading/body style.
primitives.TextField: A text input with a `label`. `variant` picks the kind: `shortText`, `longText` (multi-line), `number`, or `obscured` (a secret — note that anything typed here travels in the action context and is recorded, so never ask for a credential this way). `value` binds to the data model.
